name: Flare-ON SS
description: The standard Flare-ON: Sundancer Compact fusion, a light laser, and modest cargo capacity. The configuration most pilots mean when they say "Flare".

name: Flare-ON CX
description: Courier Flare-ON: Sundancer Compact fusion, a parcel bay, and solo transit air. Unarmed; the SS is the sport hull with a laser.

name: Flare-ON SK
description: The resort-world SK trim: gravitic Loft drive, turbo laser, and premium cabin kit. Marketed as a toy, flown like a hot rod where local gravity is strong.

name: Pegasus P101
description: The everyday Pegasus: GI hydro-thermal drive, spartan four-berth life support, useful cargo bay, and a mass driver for defence. Still the galaxy's most common private craft.

name: Pegasus P103
description: The luxury Pegasus trim: same hydro-thermal backbone as the P101, but a two-berth VitaCore cabin and no nose gun. Comfort over firepower.

name: Pegasus P103a
description: GVW's late antimatter hot rod: Ionique Annihilon drive, plasma cannon, and law-enforcement grade sensors.

name: Pegasus P105
description: Long-haul Pegasus: spartan habitat bunks, a twenty-tonne hold, large fuel tank, and hydro-thermal drive. Built to sleep aboard between ports.

name: Pegasus P107
description: Survey Pegasus: Lumina Wellhead listen array, modest fuel, and a light laser. A picket hull that trades cargo for reach.

name: Pegasus P109
description: Budget interceptor Pegasus: hot chemical drive, light plate, light and medium lasers. Slower and cheaper than the P103a law ship.

name: Pegasus P111
description: Charter Pegasus: VitaCore luxury cabin, deflector shield, and no cargo bay. The P103 still hauls freight; the P111 carries guests.

name: Pegasus P113
description: Escort Pegasus: rocket launcher, plate, and a small hold for convoy work. Support gunship, not a Wolff-class heavy.

name: Pegasus P115
description: Hopper Pegasus: four-berth habitat, small fuel, no weapons and no hold. Station-to-station shuttle on a familiar frame.

name: Krypton K2
description: The workhorse K2: Bellatrix hydro-thermal, basic laser, and a ten-tonne cargo bay. An underpowered but versatile fit for a variety of roles.

name: Krypton K3
description: The performance Krypton: Bellatrix Trace antimatter and a lighter cargo fit. For pilots who outgrew the K2's leisurely acceleration.

name: Krypton K4
description: Passenger Krypton: Orion cabin life support, small cargo, and a light laser. The K2 hauls freight; the K3 is fast; the K4 carries people.

name: Wolff Warrior
description: Gunship conversion of the Wolff freighter: antimatter drive, a Brutus scatter cannon, and a Glimmer Ember. No cargo bay and no plate. A small tank is all the frame carries.

name: Wolff Gladius
description: A modernised Wolff gunship: Privy Seal Null antimatter, deflector shield, heavier plate than the Warrior, and a Brutus scatter cannon. The rocket rack does not fit a full tank.

name: Wolff Bastion
description: The original Wolff armed freighter: Bellatrix fusion, a short unguided rocket rack, 5mm chitanium, and a ten-tonne hold. A full tank leaves no room for the twenty-tonne bay.

name: Wolff Logistico
description: Bulk Wolff freighter: ten-tonne hold, habitat bunks, fusion drive, and one light laser. A full tank will not lift the twenty-tonne bay. The Bastion is armed; the Logistico is the hold.

name: Dragon Bronze
description: An earlier Dragon without translation gear: compact fusion, light laser, and light plate. A common in-system patrol trim.

name: Dragon Post
description: Translation courier Dragon: alpha hyperdrive, compact fusion, light laser, no plasma. Bronze patrols in-system; Gold is the fighter.

name: Dragon Gold
description: The production Dragon interceptor: Bellatrix Trace antimatter, alpha hyperdrive, laser and plasma burst. SBI's tactical fighter in showroom trim.

name: Juno 1045
description: Budget Juno scout with a Tukey burner and HandyAir life support accomodations, a modest cargo capacity and a light laser. A cheap first ship for various roles.

name: Juno 1088
description: Mid trim Juno with Rhumb hydro-thermal propulsion and Circinus sensors. The fit for those who need a little more legs than the 1045 provides.

name: Juno 1090
description: Long-hop Juno model: electric-plasma Rhumb drive, channel cabin, mass driver. Heavier electronics and a defensive punch for more dangerous routes.

name: Juno 1030
description: Unarmed Juno freighter: hydro-thermal drive, HandyAir life support, and ten tonnes of hold. No weapons. A full tank will not lift the fourteen-tonne fit.

name: Juno 1060
description: Scout Juno: Circinus sensors, small fuel, one light laser, no cargo bay. Cheaper picket than the armed 1088.

name: Silhouette Mk8
description: The common Silhouette fighter fit. Drawbar chemical drive provides a punchy performance envelope. A laser and an MDC pair with light plate. The Combine's standard for orbital defence contracts.

name: Silhouette Mk6
description: Older Silhouette patrol trim: hydro-thermal drive, light laser and mass driver cannon. Still a common sight on coroprate militias, even if it is outclassed by the Mk8.

name: Silhouette Warden
description: Patrol Silhouette: Circinus sensors, one medium laser, light plate. The Mk8 is the contract fighter; the Warden is the picket.

name: Mantis XF900
description: Legacy Mantis series, out of production: Slipstream hydro-thermal, single Aegis seat, one light laser, small fuel. Still turns up on used lots and in reserve squadrons.

name: Mantis XF4400
description: Current mid-tier Mantis: Privy Seal F-11 fusion drive, light and medium lasers, Praetorium avionics. Faster and meaner than the retired XF900, still sensible on fuel.

name: Mantis XF5700
description: Top-line Mantis interceptor: Privy Seal Null antimatter and a turbo laser. The plasma burst and its cells do not fit the hull. A glass cannon for pilots who trust speed over chitanium.

name: Blackbird BB-10S
description: Basic Blackbird scout: Washi Quiet sail, Caduceus Quiet core, and passive Wellhead plus Ember listen. Armed with a light laser for Article 19 compliance without active sensor ping.

name: Blackbird BB-10R
description: Long-range Blackbird: Lumen Yard sail, Vault 7 core, and the full passive listen stack. Still no active sensor ping; the extra legs come from sail thrust and compute headroom.

name: Blackbird BB-10X
description: Premium Blackbird: same passive listen as the BB-10R, Oracle Well core, and an Orion Needle hyperdrive. The coil adds in-flight signature; spool from deep orbit on the Voltcore plant.

name: Lancer 2SV
description: Basic survey Lancer: Helios Compact plant, hydro-thermal drive, and passive Wellhead, Ember, and Sideband out to nine kilometres. Unarmed, with a four-tonne hold for field kit.

name: Lancer 2ST
description: Armed survey Lancer: the 2SV fit plus a light laser and Octant Plumb gravimetric array for active listen when the pilot accepts the ping.

name: Lancer 25S
description: Premium long-range Lancer: Rhumb Longhaul sail, large tank, Bridge 440 core, Astrolabe nav, and the full survey stack including Nexus Locus. Light laser so the hop is not helpless.

name: Lancer 2SX
description: Premium armed Lancer: full listen stack and Astrolabe, AP-56 plant with Sundancer Compact fusion, turbo laser, light plate, and medium tank. No hyperdrive.
